image_description: A group of six young adults walking outdoors on a paved path in front of a large, ornate brick university building. Five of the individuals are wearing black academic gowns over casual or semi-formal clothing. One individual on the far left wears a red jacket and jeans. The scene is bright and appears to be a graduation day celebration.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The garments are knee-length or mid-thigh length bachelor's/master's style gowns, not full-length ankle-draping robes as described in the strict taxonomy prior. They do not exhibit a rigid rectangular silhouette but rather drape naturally.
The gowns clearly feature a center-front opening and maintain bilateral symmetry in their cut.
The gowns are relatively fitted at the shoulders and arms; they do not significantly obscure body contours, especially around the legs and torso where underlying clothes are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeves are standard long sleeves ending at the wrist or slightly below, typical of modern academic dress. They do not have the distinctive 'wide open' bell shape extending well past the hands found in doctoral or ceremonial robes.
The front edges of the gowns are visible, acting as the closure panels, though no buttons/zippers are distinct.
Subjects are wearing t-shirts, jeans, and casual dresses underneath, not strictly 'formal attire' like suits or evening wear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears to be a standard matte synthetic blend common for student gowns.
The material shows low specularity, consistent with matte fabric.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Sleeves end at the wrist/hand boundary, lacking the exaggerated drape described in the taxonomy.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The architectural details of the university building in the background show slight warping and irregularities in window alignment and brick patterns, typical of AI-generated backgrounds.
Facial features have a slightly smoothed, 'waxy' appearance with inconsistent lighting reflections, particularly on the subject second from right.
Minor blending between the hands and the black fabric of the gowns, making finger definition slightly ambiguous in some areas.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the specific style of gown (bachelor/master vs doctoral) aligns with the general class label despite failing the strict 'full-length' checkpoint.
To audit the structural integrity of the limbs and ensure no extra/missing arms or legs among the group, which is a common failure mode in multi-person generations.
To analyze the perspective consistency of the complex architecture in the background and detect any spatial melting.
To check for clean separation between the black gowns and the background/other subjects, identifying any edge bleeding.

focus_areas: Limb count and connectivity for all six subjects
Architectural line straightness in the background building
Boundary sharpness between black gowns and skin/background
Consistency of gown style across all wearers

Please evaluate if this constitutes a 'class mismatch' or simply a 'subclass variation'.
